subject: Replay batch token surge — invoice hold requested and EU VAT question
messages:
From: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@nimbuslabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Labs Billing <billing@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -0500
Subject: Unknown token surge on Dec 29–30 — invoice hold requested

Hi David,

We noticed a sudden ~3.2M token increase on our Dec 29–30 usage line (attached snapshot and the Dec invoice). This looks like a background "index refresh" replay that retriggered across multiple tenants. The spike pushed us well over our committed band for December.

Can you:
- Put the Dec invoice on hold while we reconcile?
- Share per-request logs or a short export showing request_id and token_count for the window 2026-12-29 00:00 UTC — 2026-12-30 23:59 UTC?
- Clarify VAT treatment: we are an EU entity (reverse-charge) but the invoice shows standard VAT applied.

Attachments: nimbus_usage_snapshot.csv, invoice_202612.pdf

We appreciate a quick turn here — finance is holding payment until we have evidence.

Thanks,
Sandra Lee
Head of Platform Operations
Nimbus Labs
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Unknown token surge on Dec 29–30 — invoice hold requested

Hi Sandra — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We're putting a provisional hold on invoice 202612 while we investigate.

Next steps from our side:
1) Ben (billing) will pull per-request token counts for the exact window you provided.
2) Kimberly (CS) and I will review routing to confirm whether replay traffic hit EU-hosted inference pools or was routed through our global edge.
3) We will not assess late fees while the hold is active.

Could you send a short sample of request_ids (just 10–20) that you suspect are from the replay? That will speed cross-referencing. Also confirm whether the aggregated usage in the snapshot contains any internal replay IDs you can mark.

We should have an initial status update within 24 hours.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Manager — Usage & Billing
Redwood Inference
From: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@nimbuslabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Labs Billing <billing@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Unknown token surge on Dec 29–30 — invoice hold requested

David — attaching 15 sample request ids we pulled from our job logs (sample_request_ids.txt).

A few clarifications:
- The replay was triggered by our nightly index refresh job that retried on failure; it appears two retries went to your API when our worker reconnection happened.
- We run in a multi-region footprint but the jobs are set to prefer the eu-west-1 region; still possible some retried requests hit our fallback route through a global gateway.
- Regarding VAT: our purchasing team is an EU-registered entity (VAT ID provided on the PO). The invoice still shows VAT applied — we need Redwood to confirm reverse-charge treatment or correct the tax line.

Attachments: sample_request_ids.txt

Appreciate the quick help — we need evidence to unblock finance.

—Sandra
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jan 2027 10:17:00 -0500
Subject: INTERNAL: Nimbus Labs replay surge — recommended provisional credit and evidence request

Ben / Kimberly — internal notes and recommendation:

Summary: Nimbus reports ~3.2M token spike across 2026-12-29 to 2026-12-30, tied to an index-refresh replay. They provided 15 sample request_ids. They want invoice held, and VAT reversed if applicable.

Action items:
- Ops: please pull per-request telemetry for given request_ids and full window (2026-12-29 00:00 UTC — 2026-12-30 23:59 UTC). We need token_count, model_id, route_region, and retries count.
- Billing (Ben): provisionally hold invoice 202612 and prepare a tentative credit calculation. My recommendation: grant a provisional credit equal to 40% of the delta above their committed tier for Dec, pending telemetry audit. Rationale: we want to move quickly to unblock collection while protecting against abuse. If telemetry shows clear automated retries leading to duplicate billing, increase credit to full delta.
- Tax (Kimberly): review VAT on the invoice and confirm whether reverse-charge applies; if so, issue corrected invoice (zero-rated VAT) and documentation for their VAT reclaim.

Please prioritize — customer is escalating to their CFO. I'll coordinate once we have the per-request evidence.

Thanks,
David

[internal-only] Note: participants here are Redwood employees only (david_kim, ben_carter, kimberly_park).
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Unknown token surge on Dec 29–30 — provisional credit and invoice hold

Hi Sandra — quick update after our initial review.

What we did so far:
- Placed invoice 202612 on hold (no late fees while hold is active).
- Pulled a sample of request-level telemetry and matched 12 of the 15 request_ids you provided. The matched requests show multiple retries with incrementing attempt numbers and token counts consistent with replayed batches. The route_region indicates most traffic processed in eu-west-1, with ~12% routed through our global gateway during retries.

Short-term resolution:
- We applied a provisional credit equal to 40% of the net token delta above your committed band for December. This credit is visible on your account and will reflect as a credit on the outstanding invoice.
- We will keep the invoice on hold for 14 calendar days while we complete a full telemetry audit. If the audit confirms deduplicable replay behavior across the entire window, we will increase the credit to cover the full delta and issue a corrected VAT statement if reverse-charge applies.

VAT/tax: Kimberly is evaluating the paperwork you submitted. If reverse-charge applies, we will issue an amended invoice with zero-rated VAT and provide documentation for your records.

Next steps and timeline:
- Ops to deliver full window telemetry export by Jan 5 EOD.
- Billing to confirm final credit calculation by Jan 7.
- Tax to advise on amended invoice by Jan 7.

Link to provisional usage export (read-only): https://drive.redwoodinc/reports/nimbus-usage-export-20261231.csv

Please confirm you received the provisional credit and that holding the invoice for 14 days is acceptable. We'll keep you updated at each milestone.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Account Manager — Usage & Billing
Redwood Inference
